market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $50,000 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: BTC ~$78,200 with 31% rally off yearly low (~$60k). $50k requires ~36% drawdown in 8 months. Possible but the yearly-low window has already passed without hitting $50k, and momentum is bullish. Base rate for 36% BTC drawdown in 8 months is moderate but currently uptrending.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether macro tightening or risk-off resumes.
